notes.note: Bounded phone-layer history callback review at ae0e9f3e4a against placement.md and pane-relationships.md: canonical navigation retires the old layer by restoring its captured region instead of invoking the browser Back guard/reinstatement path. Actual browser Back retains its existing owner-scoped dirty guard. The real knowledge-document quote opener reproduced the stuck device layer before this fix (17 passed, 1 failed), then the profiler, quote opener, phone-layer guard and phone-layer chat-focus suites passed 31 tests in 19.97s. Existing phone-layer, canonical navigation and once-only guard claims remain accurate; this does not qualify physical/native behavior, other pane contracts or timing improvements.
